name: clan_of_embers_worker
description: a Clan of Embers Worker: a green-skinned orc with jutting tusks, an orange bandana with its knot tails flying out to the screen-left and a black topknot, a dark leather vest over a brown tunic, a belt with a brass buckle, ragged orange cloth strips, brown leg wraps with orange bands and brown boots, and a long-handled hoe with a wooden shaft and an iron blade, gripped at the end of its shaft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the hoe's shaft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the shaft lower down toward the blade, which rests on the ground at the lower-right, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the shaft, the hoe is lifted to head height with its shaft held level and its iron blade out to the right
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hoe hand behind the head and the hoe's iron blade hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the hoe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the hoe is level, its iron blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: hoe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the hoe's iron blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the hoe carries on down until its iron blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the bandana tails trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the hoe comes back to its resting slant toward the lower-right, the left hand reaching for the shaft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the hoe arm thrown up and out to the left with the hoe held level across the chest, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the hoe slanting up across the body, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the hoe arm flung up with the hoe hanging down across the body, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the hoe lowering toward the ground at the lower-right, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the hoe's iron blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the hoe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the orange bandana on his head; the hoe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the bandana tails settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the hoe on the ground beside him
